rows.en: ...To think the Data Weapons' favorite food was the Meteo Cube...
rows.notes: Shibuya addresses the GEAR group; surprise at the newly discovered food preference.

rows.en: Yes... I had no idea.
rows.notes: Vega answers Shibuya; restored I for her own lack of awareness.

rows.en: Something besides Dendoh that's been unique to Hoshimi Town for seventeen years...
rows.notes: Deduction fragment; location exclusivity and seventeen-year duration retained.

rows.en: It was Meteo and its power source, the Meteo Cube...
rows.notes: Eris continues full-original i052b:2, owned by stage24 id154; it identifies the thing present in Hoshimi besides Dendoh. Deliberate trailing sentence.

rows.en: The Data Weapons were drawn to them.
rows.notes: Eris explains the Data Weapons' attraction to Meteo and the Cube, continuing row2.

rows.en: But this is a gamble. If it fails...
rows.notes: Shibuya cautions the group; conditional deliberately leads into row5.

rows.en: We will lose another precious Meteo Cube.
rows.notes: Shibuya states the cost of failed plan; another Cube, not the only one.

rows.en: ...If we lose our battle against Gulfer, we will lose everything.
rows.notes: Vega counters Shibuya's gamble concern; loss of the war costs everything.

rows.en: And with Hau Dragon and Giganos attacking the Japan region now... we cannot afford to hesitate.
rows.notes: Vega cites ongoing Hau Dragon/Giganos attacks on Japan; urgency rather than a hypothetical.

rows.en: If Dendoh does not obtain the remaining Data Weapons here...
rows.notes: Eris states condition leading into row9; deliberate cross-row conditional.

rows.en: I think we will no longer be able to bring this chaotic situation under control.
rows.notes: Eris continues row8; restored collective we for allied efforts to resolve worsening conflict.

rows.en: Exactly! If we don't hurry and gather their friends, Leo and the others will get lonely, too.
rows.notes: Ginga supports collecting Data Weapon companions; Leo remains source-short.

rows.en: Hmm... Then I will break the seal on the Meteo Cube.
rows.notes: Shibuya decides to unseal the Cube; restored actor I from his leadership action.

rows.en: ...That is... the Meteo Cube...
rows.notes: Hokuto reacts to revealed Cube; restored is, retained astonished pauses.

rows.en: W-wow, it's smaller than I thought...
rows.notes: Ginga reacts to the Cube's size; retained initial stammer.

rows.en: Y-yeah... Since they said it was Meteo's power source...
rows.notes: Hokuto agrees with Ginga; reason clause deliberately continues into row15.

rows.en: I thought it would be bigger than the Hyper Dendoh Batteries.
rows.notes: Hokuto completes prior reason by stating his expectation about size; exact glossary battery term retained.

rows.en: You must not judge it by its appearance.
rows.notes: Inoue corrects the boys' size-based assumption; natural second-person admonition.

rows.en: Some say it is a crystal of pure energy, while others say it is a kind of medium that draws energy from somewhere else, but...
rows.notes: Inoue describes two competing explanations of Cube nature; somewhere retained, not a specified source.

rows.en: Even we have not yet determined its true nature.
rows.notes: Inoue concludes preceding but-clause; even researchers do not understand its nature.

rows.en: ...So, the Data Weapons like this thing?
rows.notes: Ginga asks whether this Cube attracts Data Weapons; Eris affirms in full-original i052b:21.

rows.en: That's right.
Meteo itself says there is a 94% probability that they do.
rows.notes: Inoue gives Meteo's own 94% assessment of the preference, not a success rate of the operation.

rows.en: But if we take this with us, won't Meteo stop working...?
rows.notes: Hokuto worries taking power source will disable Meteo; questioning trail retained.

rows.en: Don't worry. This is one of the two we have left.
rows.notes: Shibuya reassures Hokuto; two Cubes remain including this one.

rows.en: With just one, Meteo can keep running almost indefinitely.
rows.notes: Shibuya explains one Cube suffices almost indefinitely; not absolute eternity.

rows.en: Come on, let's go. We have no time to dawdle.
rows.notes: Vega leads the group to leave; inclusive let's and urgency.

rows.en: Yeah, got it.
Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Any allied unit is shot down.
rows.notes: Listener: player. Loss condition, plain text; preserves one line and the any-one-allied-unit trigger.

rows.en: Captain, we have arrived at the designated position for the operation.
rows.notes: Hari reports to Captain Ruri; operation position reached. Prefilled speaker Hari preserved.

rows.en: Then please launch the remaining units as well.
rows.notes: Ruri orders remaining allied units to launch too, implying prior launches.

rows.en: ...Everyone, Ogre will definitely show up here.
rows.notes: Vega briefs allied pilots; certainty Ogre will come to this location.

rows.en: If it takes the remaining Data Weapons, we will be in serious trouble... So please support Dendoh.
rows.notes: Vega asks allies to aid Dendoh; Ogre is the it from row27, request direction preserved.

rows.en: Yes, leave it to me.
rows.notes: George accepts Vega's request; offering himself is correct for omakase.

rows.en: Don't screw this up, Hokuto, Ginga. We'll take care of Gulfer for you.
rows.notes: Ryoko addresses Hokuto and Ginga; rough warning and commitment allies will handle Gulfer.

rows.en: Yes! Thank you very much!
rows.notes: Hokuto thanks Ryoko for covering them.

rows.en: Both of you, don't get the timing wrong. We can only do this once.
rows.notes: Eris instructs both Dendoh pilots; rows33-36 clarify signal/Cube throw, one attempt only.

rows.en: I know. I just throw the Meteo Cube the moment you give the signal, right?
rows.notes: Ginga answers Eris32; throw on her signal.

rows.en: That's right. Then the cube inside the capsule will go out of control.
rows.notes: Cube in its capsule goes out of control, not a robot.

rows.en: Out of control!? Don't tell me it's gonna explode or something!
rows.notes: Sai Saici fears an explosion; speculative alarm retained.

rows.en: No, it'll give off a very bright light. The Data Weapons will be drawn to it and come out.
rows.notes: Eris rejects explosion; bright light attracts Data Weapons out.

rows.en: Got it.
rows.notes: Hokuto acknowledges the plan.

rows.en: Harry, divide the work with Omoikane and send the tracking program to the target computer, please.
rows.notes: Ruri assigns divided work to Harry/Omoikane; source generic singular target computer retained. Body Harry, prefilled speakers unchanged.

rows.en: Yes. We just need to drive the Data Weapons out, right?
rows.notes: Hari checks objective with Ruri: drive Data Weapons out.

rows.en: Yes.
rows.notes: Ruri confirms39.

rows.en: Ruri, how long will it take to lure out the Data Weapons?
rows.notes: Vega asks Ruri remaining lure time; complete question restored.

rows.en: 125 seconds... give or take 10 seconds. About two more minutes.
rows.notes: Exact125 plus/minus10 and about two more minutes retained.

rows.en: All right.

rows.notes: Nonverbal exclamation retained exactly as ASCII punctuation.

rows.en: Enemy units approaching from above! They're identified as Gulfer!
rows.notes: Hari warns bridge of overhead approach and identified faction.

rows.en: They arrived sooner than I expected.
rows.notes: Ruri means enemy arrived sooner, not capture completion.

rows.en: Ogre...! It's Altair!!
rows.notes: Domon recognizes Ogre and its pilot Altair.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... It seems there are fewer pests in my way than usual today.
rows.notes: Altair calls the reduced defending force pests; contempt/no-softening retained.

rows.en: Altair...!
rows.notes: Vega addresses Altair in recognition; vocative fragment retained.

rows.en: Who are you...!? How do you know my name...! U-ugh!
rows.notes: Altair questions identity and knowledge of his name then groans. Interrupted name question and stutter retained.

rows.en: My name is Vega. But that name is meaningless now.
rows.notes: Vega introduces herself and says her name is now meaningless. No extra identity disclosed.

rows.en: Just like your name, Altair!
rows.notes: Comparison fragment refers to now-meaningless name in49; source omission retained.

rows.en: Grr...!
rows.notes: Growl of pain/agitation retained.

rows.en: This is the least I can do to atone. You... I will...
rows.notes: Defeating Altair is atonement; utterance split before verb at53; deliberate source fragment retained without invented past guilt.

rows.en: Defeat you!
rows.notes: Verb continuation of52; deliberate predicate fragment retained.

rows.en: Who the hell are you...!? Why do I... when it comes to you...!
rows.notes: Contemptuous identity question and unfinished reaction to Vega retained. Source cuts relation before its predicate; no recognition or memory recovery invented.
uncertain: Interrupted predicate of Altair's reaction to Vega intentionally unresolved.

rows.en: It's too late for me to tell you now!
rows.notes: Vega says explanation now would be too late; subject/action restored.
Nonverbal source exclamation retained.

rows.en: I have no choice but to defeat you now...! For your sake, too!
rows.notes: Defeating Altair is unavoidable and also for his sake; no invented killing.

rows.en: Hmph. You think a wretch like you can defeat me? What a joke!
rows.notes: Wretch preserves Altair's contempt toward Vega and exaggerated self-importance.

rows.en: Omoikane, Harry... I'm counting on you to send the tracking program.
rows.notes: Ruri asks Omoikane/Harry to transmit; explicit request direction, counting on them.

rows.en: Yes, ma'am!
rows.notes: Hari accepts Ruri's order.

rows.en: Everyone! Do whatever it takes to hold the enemy back for three minutes... until the Data Weapons appear!
rows.notes: Vega orders everyone to hold enemy at any cost. Source three minutes preserved despite Ruri42 two-minute estimate.

rows.en: If even one of our units goes down, it's all over!!
rows.notes: One friendly unit lost ends operation; complete condition and outcome retained.

rows.en: Let's go, Ogre!
rows.notes: Event8: Ginga challenges Ogre.

rows.en: I'll collect every last Data Weapon right here!
rows.notes: Hokuto vows to collect all Data Weapons here; singular subject restored.

rows.en: ...You're all bluster, as always. But you're the one going down here! Prepare yourself, Dendoh!!
rows.notes: Altair taunts Dendoh: nothing but bravado; listener will fall; prepare-yourself threat. Contempt retained.

rows.en: I won't ask who you are... But if you come at me, you are my enemy!
rows.notes: Altair responds to unidentified masked Vega; hidden relationship not revealed.

rows.en: The same goes for me! Prepare yourself, Altair!!
rows.notes: Vega reciprocates the enemy declaration and challenges Altair.

rows.en: Altair! What's behind that mask of yours!?
What do you mean, Domon Kasshu!?
rows.notes: Full source Domon Kasshu retained.

rows.en: I can tell because we've traded blows... The man you are now is a false self, bound by someone else...
rows.notes: Domon infers false controlled self through trading blows; unknown controlling party unnamed.

rows.en: Nonsense! I am Altair, captain of the Gulfer Imperial Guard!
rows.notes: Captain of Gulfer Imperial Guard from existing organization entry and sourced Altair role.

rows.en: Then my fists will smash that false mask of yours!
rows.notes: False mask preserves literal/symbolic face metaphor.

rows.en: You're good! I'm surprised there are fighters like you among the aliens!!
So are you! You're a man worthy of falling by my hand!
rows.notes: Altair declares Chibodee worthy of defeat/death at his hand; threat not softened.

rows.en: Heh... If it's a contest of speed, I've got the advantage!
Is that so!? Those legs you're so proud of might as well be standing still next to Ogre's turbines!
rows.notes: Source-short Ogre, not full Knight GEAR title; turbines retained.

rows.en: You have impressive skills! With so many warriors like you, Earth is not to be underestimated!
If you understand that much, withdraw your troops and return to your own planet!
Hm...! Its power... is it a match for Bolt Gundam...!?
rows.notes: It refers to Ogre/mecha power, not assumed pilot gender.

rows.en: Impressive...! You can withstand Ogre's power!
Since coming to this planet, I've fought machines called Gundams several times, but...
rows.notes: Deliberate clause lead-in to bizarre Nobel reveal82.

rows.en: I never expected to find such a bizarre one...!
rows.notes: Machine described as bizarre, without inventing features.

rows.en: If you can't appreciate Nobel Gundam's style, you're way too rigid!
rows.notes: Allenby defends Nobel Gundam visual style and calls Altair rigid.

rows.en: Kirakuni, get closer!
If we gather data on that Ogre, we may learn more about the Data Weapons, too!
Don't ask the impossible, Eris! If we're not careful, the Cell Fighter could go down in one hit!
rows.notes: One-hit vulnerability is conditional, not certain destruction.

rows.en: Captain! We've detected a Data Weapon signal!
Then I'm counting on you to seal the deal.
rows.notes: Ruri requests Hari/Eris follow-through; I am counting on you keeps request direction.

rows.en: Hokuto, Ginga! Now! Throw the capsule!!
Got it!!
Hm...!? What is that bastard planning?
rows.notes: Source contempt yatsu-me restored as that bastard after original single-use neighbor review. Observed boy remains unnamed; no gender or identity inserted.
uncertain: Singular target likely Ginga from following capsule throw; source does not name the observed boy.

rows.en: Goooo!!
Ngh!? What is this!?
The remaining Data Weapons...!! What's going on!?
rows.notes: Source stunned remaining-Data-Weapons fragment retained.

rows.en: We did it! It worked!!
Hokuto, Ginga! Hurry and save those three Data Weapons!!
rows.notes: Save is source-short capture operation grounded in existing File Save entry, not rescue human life.
uncertain: Save follows existing File Save convention; independent canonical English command provenance unestablished.

rows.en: Right! We just need to get close to them!!
rows.notes: They refers to three Data Weapons; approach action explicit.

rows.en: I won't let you, Dendoh!
Everyone! Stop Ogre!!
OK! Leave it to me!!
W-wait, please! There's an object approaching from above!!
rows.notes: Harry's alarm identifies an approaching object; restored existential verb. Preserve prefilled Hari speaker.

rows.en: What did you say!?
Hahahaha, I'm in luck! I've only just arrived on this planet, and I've already found what I'm after!
You're Ashura...! What have you come here for!?
Don't worry, Altair. I've no interest in the Data Weapons.
I seek only one thing... the other Hyribead that Gades desires...
rows.notes: Ashura seeks the other Hyribead for Gades; trailing ellipsis retained across explanation into 106.

rows.en: Yes, I mean that energy crystal from earlier!!
rows.notes: Identifies the Hyribead as the earlier energy crystal; restored I mean.

rows.en: What...!?
You're saying they're after the Meteo Cube!?
rows.notes: Vega reacts to Ashura's faction's target; plural they retained.

rows.en: Meteo Cube? Hmph, I don't care what it's called.
All I need is to find out where it is. Altair, do whatever you like with the Data Weapons.
Hmph, you don't need to tell me that!
Oh no!!

rows.notes: Source silence retained.

rows.en: Come, Bull Horn... Come to me!
File Save, Bull Horn!
rows.notes: Established File Save capture command retained as command fragment.

rows.en: D-dammit! Bull Horn...!!
rows.notes: Ginga reacts to Bull Horn being captured; interrupted noun fragment retained without inventing a completed event statement.

rows.en: I won't let this chance slip away! I'll save the other two as well!
Hokuto, Ginga, hurry! If they take Dragon Flare and Gatling Boar too, we'll never recover from it!
rows.notes: The remaining Data Weapons must be saved before Altair captures them; irreparable-loss warning retained.

rows.en: Y-yes!
rows.notes: Same startled assent works at both uses, answering Vega at 305 and Rom at 326.

rows.en: Whoa, hold on. I need you to tell me where the Meteo Cube is.
